01 COLORS · RINGS · LOGIC

Hanoi
Tower

A little tower for every color.

A cozy 3D puzzle about colors, sizes and clever moves. Build towers, uncover hidden rings and find a solution in fewer moves.

  • 200 levels
  • Hidden rings
  • Your own style

How to play

  1. Tap one peg, then another to move its top ring.
  2. On an occupied peg, place only a smaller ring of the same color.
  3. Bring each color together on one peg, with larger rings below smaller ones.

02 SHAPES · ARROWS · PERSPECTIVE

Arrows
Cube

A fresh perspective changes everything.

Rotate the shape, untangle the arrows and clear every face. Take your time in classic puzzles, or pick up the pace in Reactor mode.

  • 3,000 levels
  • 6 shapes
  • 12 challenges

How to play

  1. Rotate and zoom in to see where the arrows lead.
  2. Tap an arrow with a clear path. A blocked arrow costs a life.
  3. Remove every arrow. A hint or an eraser can help when you get stuck.

03 ARROWS · PATTERNS · CALM

Arrows
Cascade

Every big puzzle starts with one arrow.

Find the right order and clear the board. From simple layouts to playful shaped puzzles, discover a little more with every arrow.

  • 775 levels
  • Shaped boards
  • No timer

How to play

  1. Follow the arrows and look for one with a clear path.
  2. Remove arrows in the right order to open a way for the others.
  3. Clear the board. Each level gives you three lives, two hints and one eraser.
